game_start.intro: Na game e start. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump card: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
O cei Player {player_id} in German Whist.
{phase_info}
O tiko {hand_size} kaarte.
Play a card with '[play N]', where N is its position in your hand (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: E sega ni dua na tikinipepa e soli - sa tekivu sara ga oqo.
next_card.deck_empty: E lala na deck - e sega ni dua tale na tikite me soli.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na ivakarau ni toso e sega ni dodonu. Vakayagataka na '[play N]' mo vakatagitaka kina nai katini-ka ena ligamu.
invalid_move.bad_position: E sega ni tiko na tikina oya. O taura tu e {hand_size} na tikidua.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Mo muria na ivakaraitaki i koya e vakaliuliu qai vakayagataka tale ga nona {lead_suit} card.
invalid_move.invalid_play: E sega ni rawa me caka na ka oqori.

trick.won: Na dauqito {winner_id} e qaqa ena nona vakacakacakataki na {card}.
trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: Sa oti na nodra vuli - e bibi kece ga mera qaqa.

draw.winner_received: O sa qaqa ena ilawaki o qai taura na {card}.
draw.loser_received: O sa druka qai digitaka na {card} mai na deck.

turn.scores_learning: Tricks won so far - Player 0: {tricks0}, Player 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Phase: {phase} ({remaining_cards} kaarte qai left in the deck)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Sega ni dua na kadi e ligaqu.

trick_view.empty: E se sega ni dua na ka e caka ena qito oqo.
trick_view.header: Na ivadi e vakayagataki tiko nikua:

board_str.header: === Na QITO NI VAKATAKILAKA NA DUA ENA VOSA Vaka-JEMANI===
board_str.blank: {observation}  na kena iwiliwili e sega ni kilai.
board_str.player_line:
{observation}
Player {player_id}: {scoring} scoring tricks ({tricks} total), {hand_size} kaarte in hand

outcome.summary: Learning phase - Player 0: {l0}, Player 1: {l1}. Playing phase - Player 0: {p0}, Player 1: {p1}. Player {winner_id} wins with {winner_tricks} scoring tricks!
